content:
Hi, I’m completely new to Lean and I don’t have a mathematics background. I’m trying to get an AI-generated candidate proof checked. It concerns extending the finite-sample RACE Attention guarantee to the causal setting.

I’m not claiming the proof is correct — I’m looking for help figuring out whether it could be formalized in Lean and, if so, which lemma would make the best first thing to verify.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/sahiljoshi515/RACE_Attention/issues/8
Full proof: https://drive.google.com/file/d/11Jh_ITQWQbM40REfNayPbS98lyk0EUTG/view?usp=drive_link
If another channel is more appropriate, please let me know.
